from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashOpeningBalanceRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted cash opening balance data from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company reporting this data")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item text for the opening cash balance found in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="Numeric value of the opening cash and cash equivalents balance")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g., 'CNY', '元')")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this financial data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_opening_balances: list[CashOpeningBalanceRecord]
